note: Promotion to the tracked schema (v0.90.0, prompt 3 tranche one). Each theme in this pack names exactly one row at one grade band, not five rows across the ladder, so "unbanded": true fills each row's empty description with its own complete sentence directly — no per-band suffix, since the row already names its own grade. Theme text and grouping are copied verbatim from data/blocks.csv; nothing else is touched.
